label: Same-supporter direct presence gives all-source actual paths (inference)
rule: Actual guarded support paths, explicit source scope and existing transitive-closure well-foundedness
meaning: Replace each stipulated actual direct support edge by its one-edge nonempty path, on the concrete subtype. This is a representation weakening of the existing stronger presence input, not a defense of standing ancestry. Direct presence constrains even non-concrete candidates; no such extension is inferred in the reverse direction. The shortcut control witnesses failure of direct presence despite all-source paths.
